scope.purpose: Assess which legacy strategy content can enter the domestic personal paper-strategy case under the current reader-facing constraints.

overall_decision.required_return_language: 非保证性规划目标；以总回报和风险约束表述，不承诺保本、保收益或固定分配。

decision_table.legacy_item: Non-guarantee boundary and the distinction between distribution, NAV and total return.
decision_table.new_case_treatment: Use as a hard disclosure and product-screening boundary. The annualized goal must remain a non-guaranteed planning goal.

decision_table.legacy_item: Same-session product, market, account and look-through eligibility controls; missing evidence means no implementation.
decision_table.new_case_treatment: Rebuild a product-by-product current eligibility card. Preserve the failure-to-no-action principle, but recalibrate legacy thresholds rather than presenting them as current facts.

decision_table.legacy_item: Actual drawdown measurement, concentration, leverage and asset-quality controls.
decision_table.new_case_treatment: Reparameterize triggers, limits and stress inputs from the new mandate and actual products. Do not copy legacy weights, thresholds or scenario output.

decision_table.legacy_item: Fixed-amount mapping, prescribed sleeve weights, caps, staged allocation amounts and related arithmetic.
decision_table.new_case_treatment: Do not transfer into reader-facing materials. Rebuild the paper strategy in weights, conditions and actions without stated fixed amounts.

decision_table.legacy_item: Distribution receipt ledger, distribution-cut sensitivity and default reinvestment regime.
decision_table.new_case_treatment: Keep only the warning that distribution is not total return. Do not set a distribution, withdrawal or reinvestment target and do not use distribution yield to validate the annualized goal.

decision_table.legacy_item: Named domestic fund examples for rate bonds, dividend/low-volatility equity, gold and money-market roles.
decision_table.new_case_treatment: Start an open, role-based candidate universe. A historical code may be screened but may not be made the default or approved product without current evidence and a role-matched alternative.

decision_table.legacy_item: Public REIT and direct-stock sleeves were inactive and lacked current project or issuer evidence.
decision_table.new_case_treatment: Exclude both from the minimum starter set. Allow them only as later satellites after separate project-level or issuer-level research has passed.

decision_table.legacy_item: Long-horizon total-return sensitivity and compounding illustrations.
decision_table.new_case_treatment: Retain only the discipline that a sensitivity is not a forecast. Do not use the legacy range, formula output or any annualized figure to evidence the new goal or imply a guarantee.

decision_table.legacy_item: Conditional research sign-off and all ETF eligibility states remaining not run.
decision_table.new_case_treatment: Record as proof of historical framework review only. A new current-session evidence packet is mandatory before a product can enter the paper implementation card.

minimal_implementation_universe.selection_rule: Each active role requires a current qualified primary candidate and a role-matched alternative. Historical examples are screening seeds, not defaults.

roles.minimum_current_action: Verify institution or custodian, term, redemption, product risk and current trading conditions before use.
Compare domestic government-bond ETFs by current legal document, duration, fee, premium/discount, spread and liquidity; select only qualified candidates.
Screen dividend-quality, broad-market and low-overlap equity ETFs; verify sector, issuer-group and constituent overlap before selection.
Compare unlevered domestic spot-gold ETFs on current legal document, fee, premium/discount and liquidity; exclude futures, financing and leveraged products.
Complete project cash-flow, debt, valuation-premium, trading-liquidity and minimum-lot research before considering any candidate.
Complete standalone valuation, cash-flow coverage, capital-structure, sector-cycle and liquidity research before considering any candidate.

personal_action_sequence: Confirm horizon, drawdown capacity, account permission and tax boundary before selecting active roles.
Create a dated eligibility card for every candidate: formal document and fee, same-session market evidence, account feasibility, minimum lot, look-through and source timestamp.
Choose a primary product only from qualified candidates and retain a role-matched alternative; failed, suspended, anomalously priced or undocumented candidates receive no action.
Track the paper strategy through pre-disclosed weights, staging logic and observed drawdown, not short-term price movement, historical distributions or the annualized goal.
Keep REITs and direct stocks behind their separate research gates; never add them merely to fill a target.
explicit_exclusions: No stated fixed amount in reader-facing material.
No cash-distribution, withdrawal or reinvestment target.
No closed code list or historical-product default.
No capital-protection, return-guarantee or fixed-income claim.

required_current_evidence: Current formal document, fee, benchmark or underlying and holdings for each actual candidate.
Same-session price reference, premium/discount, bid-ask spread, liquidity or executable depth, timestamp and raw-record hash.
Account suitability, minimum-lot and settlement feasibility for the intended domestic personal account.
Equity look-through overlap; REIT project evidence; standalone issuer valuation where those satellites are proposed.
A total-return stress test incorporating fees, taxes, liquidity and account-value-loss risk without using distribution yield or legacy sensitivity as a proxy.

self_check.result: PASS: a01 legacy strategy audit is structurally complete; source anchors resolve; no prohibited amount-language token detected.
